# Welcome to Inkflit

A small notebook that stays out of the way. Call it up, write, and it saves as you type.
// These guide notes are yours to edit or delete. Settings → Restore Guide Notes brings them back.

## Show and hide
- `⌃⌥Space` shows or hides Inkflit from any app (the default; change it in Settings → General).
- `Esc` hides it, and so does switching to another app.
- The window opens on the display under the pointer, on the desktop you are using.

## Notes are pages
- New notes are added at the end, like pages in a notebook: `⌘N`.
- Turn pages with `⌘[` and `⌘]`, or jump to a page with `⌘1` … `⌘9`.
- The footer shows when the current note was created.

## Deleting
- `⌘D` deletes the current note right away.
- Changed your mind? Press `⌘U` within 12 seconds.
- Older deletions wait in the Trash: Settings → Data.

Next page: writing. Press `⌘]`.

# Writing

Notes are plain Markdown, styled as you type.

## Markdown
- `#` starts a heading; `**bold**` and `*italic*` work as usual.
- `- item` makes a list, and `- [ ] task` a checkbox you can click.
- Put `inline code` between backticks.
- A line starting with `//` is a comment. `⌘/` comments or uncomments lines.

- [ ] Try ticking this box
- [x] This one is done

## Vim keys
Inkflit starts in NORMAL mode, shown in the footer.
- `i` starts typing; `Esc` goes back to NORMAL; `Esc` again hides the window.
- `u` undoes and `⌃R` redoes. Hold `j` or `k` to keep moving.
- `/text` searches this note; `n` finds the next match.
// Prefer to type directly? Turn Vim off in Settings → Edit.

# Checklists and calculations

Feature blocks turn part of a note into a small tool.
// To add one, type / on an empty line (in INSERT mode), then pick a block.

## Checklist
// Click a box, or type /x at the end of a line.
:::inkflit list
Try a checklist
  A child item
[x] Finished item
:::end

- `Tab` / `⇧Tab` indent and outdent; children move with their parent.

## Math
// A line ending in = is calculated. Variables stay inside this block.
:::inkflit math
price: 80
price * 2 =
10 km to mi =
10 USD to EUR =
:::end

## Working with blocks
- `⌘K` changes the block type, turns it back into text, or deletes it.
- `⌘⇧D` deletes the current block. Every change can be undone.
- `⌘O` / `⌘⇧O` add an empty line below / above the block.
- `Return` on a block's last empty line leaves the block.

# Sum, average and count

These blocks read the numbers or items inside them and show a result under the block.
// Change a value and watch the result update. Lines starting with // are skipped.

## Sum
:::inkflit sum
Coffee 12
Lunch 28
:::end

## Average
:::inkflit avg
10
20
30
:::end

## Count
:::inkflit count
A short item
Another item
:::end

- Sum and average use the numbers on each line; they do not evaluate expressions.
- Count shows items, words and characters.

# Code

Code blocks highlight their language and help with brackets and indentation.
// Pick a language in the block header, or press ⌘L inside the block.

:::inkflit code javascript
const greeting = "Hello, Inkflit!";
console.log(greeting);
:::end

- Brackets and quotes close themselves; `Return` keeps the indentation.
- `Tab` / `⇧Tab` indent and outdent.
- With nothing selected, `⌘C` copies the whole block.
- `⌘/` comments lines in the block's own language.

## Settings
- Settings → Edit: indentation (2 spaces, 4 spaces or tabs).
- Settings → Appearance: code colors, with a live preview.

# Snippets

Type `@` and a word to insert a value. Try it on the empty line below.


## Built-in
- `@date`, `@time`, `@now`: today, the time, or both, in several formats.
- `@year`, `@month`, `@day`, `@week`: parts of the date.
- `@timestamp`, `@uuid`: a Unix time or a random ID.
- `@ip`, `@mac`, `@host`: network addresses, the computer name and your account.

## Choosing a format
- `@date` lists every date format; `Return` inserts the first.
- `↑` / `↓` pick another; `Esc` closes the list.
- Letters in order also work: `@wk` finds `@week`.

## Your own
- Add them in Settings → Snippets, or with Manage snippets in `⌘⇧P`.
- Several rows can share a trigger: two `@addr` rows, home and office.
- Placeholders insert other snippets: `{date}`, `{date#2}`, `{ipv4}`.

# Search, commands and your notes

## Find
- `⌘⇧F` searches all notes. With an empty field it lists every note.
- `↑` / `↓` choose, `Return` opens, `Esc` closes.

## Command palette
- `⌘⇧P` runs note actions and changes settings without opening Settings.
- Rows marked › open choices, such as the accent color or the language.
- For opacity, blur and backups you can type a number, such as 80.

## Where your notes live
- Each note is a Markdown file in Documents/Inkflit, on your Mac only.
- Previous versions are kept as you edit; deleted notes go to the Trash.
- Settings → Data changes the folder, restores versions and deleted notes.
// Inkflit has no cloud sync. Include the folder in your own backups.
